paragraphs: Risk-management infrastructure under regime uncertainty for corn front-month futures (ZC=F), built end-to-end on free public data.

This is not a price predictor. Across a 2020–2026 walk-forward evaluation, no model here beats a naive random walk on the 30-day point forecast — and the system is built to be honest about that. Its job is to quantify what it doesn't know: a calibrated 80% interval, an explicit map of which market regime conditions resemble, and a plain-language read of both. The value is calibrated honesty about uncertainty, not a sharper guess.

These regimes are never handed to the model as discrete labels. They justify a set of continuous regime features — volatility percentile, positioning extremity, drought change, macro state — that let a single forecaster condition on the state of the world instead of averaging over incompatible ones. The system's job is to recognize the regime it is in and to widen its uncertainty when that regime is unfamiliar.
features: Forecast — the 30-day outlook as an uncertainty cone: a random-walk center with a conformal-calibrated 80% band.
Model card — what the model is, what it can and can't do, and the coverage it actually achieves.
Scenario — a producer-facing narration of the current band and regime.
